🎥🎬: Community (2009–2015)

Jeff Winger is a smooth-talking lawyer whose degree turns out to be fake, forcing him to enroll at Greendale Community College to earn a legitimate one. Hoping to win over a classmate, Jeff creates a study group, but it quickly becomes a genuine friendship between a wildly different group of students.

Together, Jeff, Britta, Abed, Troy, Shirley, Annie, and Pierce navigate college life while getting caught in increasingly ridiculous adventures. From paintball wars and elaborate schemes to bizarre alternate realities and meta jokes, the group slowly becomes a dysfunctional but surprisingly close-knit family.

source_details.synopsis: Community is an American television sitcom created by Dan Harmon. The series ran for 110 episodes over six seasons, with its first five seasons airing on NBC from September 17, 2009, to April 17, 2014, and its final season airing on Yahoo Screen from March 17 to June 2, 2015. Set at a community college in the fictional Colorado town of Greendale, the series stars an ensemble cast including Joel McHale, Gillian Jacobs, Danny Pudi, Yvette Nicole Brown, Alison Brie, Donald Glover, Ken Jeong, Chevy Chase, and Jim Rash.
